provenance.paper_title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Historical frames are stored without post-processing and retrieved by field-of-view overlap.

Each generated segment appends new frames to the historical context memory under a fixed rule. For Context-as-Memory, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of historical generated frames.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (historical generated frames) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
